Address the effect by match name or index, not 'Size'. Recolour via Contents > Fill/Stroke.

cards.scripting: Tone synthesises audio on whatever layer carries it: add a solid (comp.layers.addSolid), set l.enabled = false (hide its picture, audio still plays) and apply with preset(l, comp, file, t) where t is where the sound should start. cards.name: Blue Bars
cards.summary: An animated blue bar background: Fractal Noise chunked by Mosaic into 15 vertical bars (15 x 1 blocks), coloured blue/navy by Tritone, then scaled 200% and rotated by the Transform effect so the bars tilt and swing from +25 to -25 deg while their brightness shimmers as the noise evolves.
use_for: Tech or data-themed background behind stats in an explainer
Digital texture under a cyber or AI segment title
Blue backdrop to test lower thirds on
